_notes: Models swap by editing this file. length/frontZ/topY fit the glb into the rig's gun space (metres, -z forward, y up). Shotgun (client package lab/shotgun.glb) has no slot: Saltline is a two-weapon rig. Sources and licences: docs/assets.md. rifle.sights adds the ADS overlay (src/weapons/sights.js): eyeY is the eye line the ADS pose aims down, front/rear place the post+dot and the aperture ring, hide drops GLB parts that would block the ring. The hammer is procedural (src/weapons/hammer.js).
